explication: This repository is a collection of numbered tutorial lessons and example applications, not one deployable product with a single user workflow. The README highlights cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, Argo CD, and benchmarking; the tree also contains many web-service implementations. Sampled source shows device APIs and image upload/storage in particular Rust examples. The graph captures those concrete components and their documented or indexed links; many other lesson implementations are unsampled, so their internal relationships are not inferred.
